## Changes

### Features

- Add drag-and-drop card reordering on Dashboard with persistent display order

### Bug Fixes

- Fix Clone with Settings to properly reload customizations
- Fix Copy/Paste config link to update local state after saving
- Smooth drag-and-drop card settle animation (eliminates visual snap)
- Prevent long filenames from overflowing Override dialog badge

### Refactoring

- Extract Dashboard components and context to eliminate prop drilling
- Unify VersionCard action callbacks into single interface
- Share color constants across Dashboard components
- Clean up drag-and-drop overlay system
